name: cur1_3v3
notes: Phase D, first curriculum (user: train 1v0 -> 5v5 from scratch, 2026-11-27). Slots observation (76 numbers, every size, teammates' calls), the net calls (15 outputs, calls unrewarded), from scratch at lr 3e-4. Each stage starts from the previous stage's best checkpoint and stops at its budget or after 4 estimated Elos (every 50 updates, 24 matches at the stage's size) without beating the best by 25, after 400 updates. Opponents: the new rule-based archetypes (engine 2) at the stage's size + self-play. Question: does a net trained up the sizes reach the rule players at each size, and what do its calls come to mean?
